en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a metal bridge with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn or early motor carriage, and tram tracks crossing a wide river. On the opposite bank stands a dense old town of gabled houses climbing a hill. Dominating the skyline is a large medieval hilltop complex with fortified walls and tall twin‑spired Gothic church towers, resembling a cathedral integrated into a castle‑like palace. The overall style and clothing of people suggest an early‑20th‑century scene.
